headline: Flights from Toronto to U.S. delayed due to ‘extraordinary circumstances’
briefing: Top stories right now: Flights from Toronto to U.S. delayed due to ‘extraordinary circumstances’; US flight outage live updates: Trump officials set to brief public hours after FAA grounds thousands of flights; and “We’re Not Going to Toronto”: Connor McDavid’s Wife Lauren Responds to Maple Leafs Speculation.

keyDates.label: New municipal term; Israeli cabinet meets
keyDates.why: Ontario councils and the appointed regional chairs begin their four-year term, Israel's security cabinet meets after ordering readiness for a possible Iran strike, and the Southeast Asian summit Carney is attending opens in Manila.

keyDates.label: Canada inflation report; OSAP bill expected
keyDates.why: Statistics Canada reports October consumer prices, the last reading before the Bank of Canada's next decision, and Ontario is expected to table its bill on student aid at private career colleges.

keyDates.label: APEC summit; Alaska ranked-choice count
keyDates.why: Carney meets Xi in Shenzhen on Nov. 18–19, and Alaska tabulates its Peltola–Sullivan Senate race.

keyDates.label: Senate Democrats vote; Stelco recall
keyDates.why: Democratic senators choose between Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen for majority leader by secret ballot, and 175 laid-off Stelco workers are due back in Hamilton.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
keyDates.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.

keyDates.label: Stellantis default deadline
keyDates.why: The 30 days Ottawa gave Stellantis on Nov. 12 to repay subsidies or reverse course run out, after which the government says it will sue.

stories.now: PBS NewsHour: Unlike modern web apps or authentication gatekeepers, email wasn't designed to fail fast, meaning to immediately halt when a problem arises. Al Jazeera: Governments, businesses, individuals were disrupted globally as server failures stretch into second day.
stories.backstory: Many hospitals, universities, governments and businesses rent email and office software from Microsoft as an online service, known as Microsoft 365, rather than running their own servers. That means a single fault at the company can hit thousands of organizations at once. In July 2024 a faulty update from security firm CrowdStrike crashed Windows computers worldwide and disrupted GTA hospitals and airports. Ontario hospitals use Code Grey to signal the loss of essential infrastructure such as power, water or computer systems.

stories.headline: More electric vehicles exempt from luxury tax, Ottawa says
stories.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne announced that starting Friday, all electric vehicles that cost less than $150,000 would be exempt from the 10 per cent tax.

sources.title: Global News: More electric vehicles exempt from luxury tax, Ottawa says

stories.backstory: The federal luxury tax took effect in September 2022 and applies to new cars and aircraft priced above $100,000 and boats above $250,000. Electric vehicles tend to cost more than comparable gas models, so more of them cross the line. The government tabled its 2026 budget on Nov. 5.
